results.title: Kylie Jenner Makes Victoria's Secret Fashion Show Debut, Wearing $50 Million Bra
results.description: Kylie Jenner made her Victoria's Secret Fashion Show debut on Sunday, October 18, wearing a $50 million bra and a pair of feathered wings. The reality star, 29, appeared on the runway for the first time, sizzling in a bejeweled silver bra and high-waisted thong, paired with transparent stilettos.

results.title: Celebrity Traitors star signs up for Gogglebox – along with his TWO relatives
